movie.title: Coco 2
movie.overview: Three years after Miguel Rivera risked everything to bring harmony back to his family, the teenager has been filling the streets of Santa Cecilia with his music. But on the eve of an important audition, Miguel's dreams are threatened when Ernesto de la Cruz - the fallen idol who won't stay forgotten - returns for a vengeful encore. Miguel travels back to the Land of the Dead to reclaim the one thing he cannot live without, and learns that this time it will take more than a song to save what matters most.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Following his musical journey to the Land of the Dead, young Miguel embarks on a new heartwarming adventure that deepens his connection to his family's heritage and music.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In this sequel to the acclaimed 2017 animated film, Miguel continues to explore his passion for music while uncovering new mysteries surrounding his ancestors. As another seasonal celebration approaches, a unexpected discovery leads him back into extraordinary realms beyond his hometown of Santa Cecilia. Alongside beloved returning characters and vibrant new spirits, Miguel learns even deeper lessons about memory, family bonds, and legacy. The journey weaves captivating original music with a rich exploration of culture and family history.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Set after the transformative events of the original story, Coco 2 follows Miguel Rivera as he balances his everyday life in Santa Cecilia with his refined musical talents. When an unexpected clue regarding his family tree surfaces during preparations for the next Dia de los Muertos, Miguel finds himself drawn into a fresh adventure spanning both the living world and the mystical realm beyond. Seeking to resolve a forgotten historical puzzle, he reconnects with his energetic ancestors while encountering fascinating new spirit guides. Throughout the journey, Miguel's dedication to his family's legacy is put to the test as new musical dynamics and secrets unfold. Alongside his trusted companions, he navigates vibrant landscapes filled with rich tradition, colorful alebrijes, and enchanting melodies. As hidden truths come to light, the Rivera family must unite across generations to honor their past and protect their shared future. Ultimately, Miguel realizes that the true power of music lies in its ability to bridge time, heal old wounds, and strengthen the ties that bind families together.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Coco 2 expands upon the vibrant universe introduced in the original 2017 masterpiece, continuing the story of young Miguel and his deeply musical family. Blending themes of tradition, family ties, and extraordinary cultural heritage, this story follows Miguel as a new mystery brings the realms of the living and the dead together once more. Packed with colorful animation, rich folklore, and compelling musical performances, this spoiler-free continuation offers an uplifting, heartwarming experience for audiences of all ages.

story_structure.climax: A high-stakes emotional confrontation takes place where Miguel must rely on the power of music and family legacy to prevent a permanent rift between worlds.
story_structure.conflict: A new unexpected predicament or mysterious connection involving the Land of the Dead arises, threatening the harmony between the living and their ancestors.
story_structure.resolution: Balance is restored across both realms, deepening the Rivera family's understanding of love, memory, and traditional heritage.
story_structure.introduction: Miguel and the Rivera family continue their daily lives in Santa Cecilia, balancing their deep musical roots with their traditional family shoemaking heritage.
story_structure.risingAction: Miguel embarks on a fresh journey into the spirit world alongside familiar allies, navigating uncharted magical realms and unraveling long-buried secrets.
